note: Canonical half of the mnemonic-spelling pair. The symbol and edge lists here are byte-identical to mnemonic_alias.expected.json by design: the two source files express the same logic in different spellings and MUST extract identically. This fixture is expected to pass before canonicalization is wired in; its alias twin is expected to fail until then. Per plcHandoff.md the canonical spelling feeds edges and stable IDs while mnemonic_raw preserves what was written, so canonicalization must not be a config flag - flipping one would silently invalidate every stable ID in the index.
